Перед `finish` ещё раз прогоню проверки на опубликованном `headSha`.```json
{"version":1,"taskId":"a774d560-174b-4dd3-aa4b-e675234cf2f5","commandId":"verify-final-1","operation":"run","headSha":"a4bf6e68d1ec87f6ea1faaf321505c380d437763","timeoutSeconds":300,"command":"set -euo pipefail
npm run build -w @msngr/shared
npm run build -w @msngr/server
npm run typecheck
npm run lint
npm test
echo OK_FINAL
"}
```

Жду `verify-final-1`, затем отправлю `finish`.
